names.official: Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis

summary: Nationals of the 67 countries and territories on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' visa-required list need a visa for Saint Kitts and Nevis, applied for online through the Ministry of National Security's e-visa platform; the ministry does not say that every other nationality is exempt. Every foreign visitor must obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA, USD 17) online before travel.

notes: The UK Foreign Office says it is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing, with a fine of EC$250 and 3 months in prison; the Government of Canada adds that carrying items made of camouflage material is also illegal.
You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty, according to the UK Foreign Office.

The UK Foreign Office says drug offences carry severe penalties: on conviction at a Magistrates Court, a fine of up to EC$400,000 or 3 times the street value, whichever is higher, and up to 10 years in prison; High Court sentences start at 15 years. Personal-use cannabis is decriminalised but needs a licence.

payments.text: The Government of Canada says US currency and major credit cards are accepted and ATMs are widely available. The UK Foreign Office notes that taxis are not metered and can often be paid in US dollars as well as EC dollars.

safety.text: Canada advises normal security precautions in Saint Kitts and Nevis. Petty crime such as pickpocketing and purse snatching occurs, as does violent crime including armed robbery and sexual assault; avoid isolated areas and unpatrolled beaches after dark, and keep car doors locked when driving.

tips.text: The hurricane season runs from June to November, according to the UK Foreign Office and the Government of Canada. Canada says even small tropical storms can quickly develop into major hurricanes during this period, and to weigh the risks carefully when planning a trip in that season.

Canada says traffic drives on the left. The UK Foreign Office says you must have a St Kitts and Nevis driving licence and describes a temporary one from the Inland Revenue Department, valid for 3 months (EC$62.50) or one year (EC$125); the Ministry of National Security's border portal sells a visitor's temporary driver's licence for 3 days (USD 10) or 90 days (USD 24).
St Kitts and Nevis are separate islands; the Government of Canada says ferry services run between them and to Antigua and Barbuda and Montserrat.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Saint Kitts and Nevis?
faq.answer: Nationals of the 67 countries and territories on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' visa-required list need a visa, applied for online through the Ministry of National Security's e-visa platform. The ministry does not say that all other nationalities are exempt; the UK, Canadian and Italian governments say their citizens need no visa, and Taiwan's Bureau of Consular Affairs says the same for its passport holders. Every foreign visitor must also obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA, USD 17) at knatravelform.kn before travel.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Saint Kitts and Nevis without a visa?
faq.answer: No official source we could read states a general length of stay for visa-exempt visitors. The UK government says British visitors can stay without a visa for up to 6 months and must apply and pay for any extension through the St Kitts and Nevis Immigration Department.

faq.question: Is there an arrival form for Saint Kitts and Nevis?
faq.answer: Yes. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs says citizens and visitors must complete the online Immigration and Customs (ED) form at knatravelform.kn. Fill it in before you travel, or on arrival on your own device.

faq.question: Can Chinese citizens travel to Saint Kitts and Nevis visa-free?
faq.answer: No official source we could read says. Mainland China is not on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' list of the 67 countries and territories whose nationals need a visa, but the ministry does not say that nationalities missing from it are exempt. Taiwan's Bureau of Consular Affairs says Republic of China passport holders can stay up to 90 days for tourism or business. Every foreign visitor must obtain an Electronic Travel Authorisation (eTA, USD 17) at knatravelform.kn before travel.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever certificate for Saint Kitts and Nevis?
faq.answer: The eTA platform run by the Ministry of National Security says there are currently no vaccination requirements to enter. WHO's list still shows a certificate requirement for arrivals aged 1 and over from yellow fever risk countries.

faq.question: Does CARICOM free movement apply here?
faq.answer: No official source we could read states the length of stay Saint Kitts and Nevis grants CARICOM nationals on arrival. The Ministry of National Security's eTA platform says an eTA at knatravelform.kn is required of all foreign visitors, and that OECS nationals can use their national ID card to apply.
